facts.text: St. Olaf College operates on a 4-1-4 academic schedule where all first-year students are required to take a January Term class on campus, and students must complete 3 full January Term credits to graduate.

sources.title: January – Parents & Families - St. Olaf College
sources.quote: Overall, the 4-1-4 schedule St. Olaf follows improves the quality of academic instruction by concentrating student effort on fewer courses at one time

facts.text: St. Olaf College meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for all admitted students.

sources.title: Applying Early – Admissions - St. Olaf College
sources.quote: St. Olaf meets 100% of demonstrated financial need. When we say we meet the demonstrated need of ALL admitted students, we mean it.
